turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Let me show you one first.
I have ___ egg. "Egg" starts with the sound "e", so I write: I have an egg.
The rule: use "an" before a vowel sound (a, e, i, o, u), and "a" before other sounds.
Right: I see a cat. Wrong: I see an cat.
Now you. Write a or an: She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
